title: Introducing Discovery Agent
summary: Laylo's new Discovery Agent recommends your upcoming shows to a growing network of more than 250,000 opted-in fans, based on the artists they already listen to.
body_markdown:
## Introducing Discovery Agent


October 8, 2026


Saj SanghviCo-Founder


"Does Laylo help me get exposure?" It's one of the most common questions we've heard since we started Laylo.


The honest answer used to be no. CRMs, ours included, are built to re-engage the fans you already have. If a fan never gave you their number, no CRM could reach them for you.


That question has always stuck with me, because every show has fans in that city who listen to you and never hear about the date.


Today we're launching[Discovery Agent](https://laylo.com/ai-agents/discovery-agent) to change that.


Discovery Agent recommends your upcoming shows to fans across Laylo's network. Fans opt in on[discover.laylo.com](https://discover.laylo.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=owned&utm_campaign=discoveryagent&utm_content=founder-blog-fan-signup) , connect Spotify, and get one text a month with the shows near them, for artists they listen to. If your show fits, it's in that text, linked to whatever ticketing you already use. Your own list stays untouched.


### An audience built for discovery


Over the past year, we quietly built our own audience on Laylo: a growing network of more than 250,000 opted-in fans who want to hear about artists they might like but don't follow yet. It was a long investment. Now every artist on Laylo Pro and Enterprise can reach fans outside their own list.


### Already working for you


Discovery Agent has already sent 80,000+ show recommendations for nearly 600 artists. Use it to:


- Put a new city's date in front of fans who stream you there.
- Reach fans who missed your announcement.
- Send every click to your own ticket link, and see each one in Laylo.


Add your Spotify artist link and a drop or multidrop with your show dates, and it works while you sleep. It's included with Laylo Pro and Enterprise at no cost, and Laylo takes no commission on the tickets it moves.


Discovery Agent is for artists today. Check your Spotify link before your next run of dates.


**— Saj Sanghvi, Co-Founder**
